• Could Tagarapuvalasa become Vizag’s next KOKAPET?*
Bhogapuram International Airport is changing the growth story of the northern Visakhapatnam region. But the bigger question is — *which locations could benefit from the economic activity developing around the airport?*
In this video, we take a detailed look at *Tagarapuvalasa* & why it could potentially emerge as an important growth & connectivity node between *Bhogapuram, Vizianagaram, Bheemili & Visakhapatnam.*
